# LibrePaint iPadOS bug report

Please use this repository's iPadOS bug report form so that the device,
installation, reproduction, and diagnostic information is included.

This repository tracks problems specific to LibrePaint on iPadOS. Bugs that also
reproduce in an official desktop or Android build of Krita belong in the
[upstream Krita bug tracker](https://bugs.kde.org/).

Do not attach Apple IDs, certificates, provisioning profiles, device
credentials, or other signing secrets.
